content:
alex: heads up — stellaris-17b (17B int4) canary is hitting OOMs on cold starts when batch bursts hit ~6 concurrent requests. root log snippet:

alex: ```
[2026-03-19 14:12:07] ERROR runtime: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
stack: allocate_kv_cache -> allocate_attention -> ...
node-34: free_blocks: fragmented 78% contiguous: 2MB
```

priya: timeline? how often does it reproduce? :eyes:

alex: reproduces locally on canary nodes within 15-30s of traffic spike. only on int4 build, float16 version fine.

jamie: config we used:

jamie: ```yaml
model: stellaris-17b
quant: int4
canary:
  wave_size: 10
  slow_start: true
  reserve_slots: 1
runtime:
  batching:
    target_batch_tokens: 2048
    max_batch_size: 8
  prefetch_kv: true
  max_new_tokens_default: 64
```

sandeep: two quick hypotheses:
1) int4 increases working set and causes KV chunk fragmentation on cold alloc
2) prefetch combined with large target_batch_tokens forces many concurrent allocs

priya: I can run a controlled repro with scripted bursts and capture cuda memory maps. will do today.

jamie: interim mitigations I suggest:
- disable prefetch_kv on canary
- enable slow-start with reserve_slots=2
- lower max_new_tokens default to 16 for canary
- add a small warmup priming request for each model host after rollout

alex: agreed. also let's try KV zone compaction on idle windows (run compaction every 5m) and reduce target_batch_tokens to 1024.

ops-bot: deploy/patch/2026-03-19T14:20Z applied to canary cluster: prefetch_kv=false, target_batch_tokens=1024

sandeep: please also capture fragmentation metrics: node.vm.fragmentation_ratio and cuda_free_contiguous before/after.

jamie: scheduling a canary wave tonight 02:00 UTC with traffic ramp 0 -> 5 rps over 10m. will post results.

priya: running repro now with synthetic prompt set (long dialogs + streaming). attaching quick diff when done.

alex: thanks — if this reduces OOMs we can codify as a per-model onboarding checklist: default prefetch=false for int4, slow-start rollout, reserve slots, warmup priming, KV compaction schedule.

sandeep: one more: add a circuit-breaker that force-falls back to fp16 variant when contiguous free < 16MB.

jamie: noted. I'll open a PR for the fallback policy and add a small experiment metric (fallback_count).

alex: assignment:
- priya: repro + fragments (today)
- jamie: rollout + PR for fallback (tonight)
- sandeep: compaction script + metrics (tomorrow)

alex: tagging @oncall for visibility :bell:

ops-bot: incident/notice posted in #incidents

priya: quick update — repro showed fragmentation spike only on hosts that handled heavy batching and prefetch enabled. initial mitigation reduced OOMs by ~90% in 30m smoke.

alex: awesome. will follow up with a short postmortem and checklist to onboarding docs.

jamie: cool, closing out this thread after validation. :thumbsup:
